about: meta QA 11-25 rows 82 and 119: script paths that point where nothing is, still carried, each with why its fix is not this repo's; shrink only (node .githooks/script-paths.mjs --prune).

findings.finding: scripts/blender/: stray in scripts/ (src/scripts/ is the lean home: move it under src/, or baseline why it stays)
findings.why: The installed engine lint (wildshard/no-shard-runtime) finds this shard's registered Blender .mjs helpers only through scripts/blender/targets.json; the move to src/blender/targets.json waits on engine's fix (meta QA 11-25 row 129) reaching this repo's SDK pin. The SDK's build.sh already reads either place (sharddev 220ea7e7).
